payload.reason: The evidence provides specific results from the experiments conducted on the dataset for fine-grained sentiment analysis, including performance metrics and comparisons to previous datasets.

claims.text: The baseline model achieved Proportional F1 scores of .41, .31, and .31 for Holders, Targets, and Polar Expressions, respectively, and Binary F1 scores of .41, .36, and .56.
The results indicate that the domain variation leads to lower overlap between training and test data, with overlaps of 56%, 28%, and 50% for Holders, Targets, and Polar Expressions.
The dataset NoReC_fine was introduced as a benchmark for further experiments in fine-grained sentiment analysis in Norwegian.
